**Summary of Round 1**

**Agreement:** All panelists agree that the contractor dispute halted work for **5 months** in 2023. Five of six panelists agree the upgraded design capacity is **62 million litres per day**. Two panelists additionally note the pre-upgrade capacity was 45 million litres per day.

**Disagreement:** One panelist states the upgraded design capacity is **68 million litres per day**, diverging from the majority figure of 62.

**Key figures in play:**

| Item | Figures offered |
|---|---|
| Upgraded capacity | 62 million L/day (×5); 68 million L/day (×1) |
| Original capacity | 45 million L/day (×2) |
| Halt duration | 5 months (×6) |

The sole point of contention for Round 2 is the upgraded design capacity: 62 vs. 68 million litres per day. Panelists are invited to reconsider in light of the evidence cited (E3).

**Round-1 Summary**

**Disagreement:** One panelist gave a design capacity of **68 million litres per day** instead of 62.

**Evidence-check findings:** The automated tool flagged the 68 million litres per day figure as **contradicted by the evidence packet**. All other answers passed the check with no problems found.
